entities.summary: Ada Marshania is an ethnic Abkhaz and became the Deputy of the Supreme Council of the de jure Government of Abkhazia in exile in Georgia upon the resignation of Temur Mzhavia, the former holder of that title, in July 2006. She was a member of the Parliament of Georgia. She represented the Alliance of Patriots of Georgia until 2021.
